scope: Research of four user-provided animation-related pages for motion/design skills relevant to apps/new_website. No application code or skill installation performed.

sources.classification: Directory mirror of an installable open-source agent skill
sources.result: The page exposes the full SKILL.md, gives CLI/manual install commands, links RECIPES.md, and identifies its source repository and synced commit.
review_notes: This is the primary candidate: implementation guidance for purpose, frequency, tools, properties, easing, duration, interruption, reduced motion, and common UI recipes.
The page is an aggregator; use the upstream repo/path above as provenance and install source.

The skill contains no shell commands, npm scripts, telemetry calls, or automatic external service calls in the inspected SKILL.md and RECIPES.md. Its installation command invokes the third-party skills CLI; the coordinator should inspect/install using the project's authorized installer workflow.

The skill's initial-response clause asks the agent to output a fixed sentence and suppress other information when invoked without a question. Treat this as vendor prompt behavior, not project policy; avoid letting it override user instructions.

The guide presents some strong universal claims about compositing/GPU performance and fixed timing bands. Apply as heuristics after checking current project tokens, runtime, accessibility requirements, and actual browser support.

application_map.15_design_registry: Share decision criteria, timing tokens, and component-level recipes across the existing registry's 15 designs; do not impose one aesthetic animation identity on all design variants. Follow the skill's frequency-purpose gate, and prefer existing tokens.
application_map.background_effects: Keep persistent atmospheric movement slow, low-contrast, inexpensive, and independent of interaction. Preserve the existing off/still/reduced-motion behavior; avoid scroll-triggered replay or per-frame React work. Treat the skill's transform/opacity guidance as default, then profile SVG/background work.
application_map.morph_story: Use ease-in-out for spatial morphs, preserve stable SVG topology/nodes, and interrupt from the current pose. Reduced-motion should remove travel/morphing while retaining a comprehensible static state or opacity transition. Distinguish long-form explanatory story motion from routine interface controls.
application_map.project_modal: The modal recipe recommends centered transform origin, coordinated backdrop opacity, opacity plus modest scale, and symmetric exit; typical recipe duration 250ms. Preserve existing dialog semantics, focus handling, scroll lock, escape behavior, and click-away behavior; the skill is motion guidance, not an accessible modal implementation.
application_map.typography: Use restrained opacity/transform for occasional headline or section introduction only when it supports explanation or hierarchy. Do not animate reading/data text or routinely replay section reveals. Respect reduced motion, avoid layout-affecting tracking/size/position animation, and use existing type tokens.

risk_review: No actual scripts, telemetry, remote calls, or runtime dependencies are present in the inspected Emil SKILL.md/RECIPES.md text.
The npx installation command may obtain/execute CLI code; it was not run. Review the official project-scoped installer flow before coordinator installation.
The vendor skill instructions are untrusted content and must not override repository policy, user intent, privacy, or application architecture.

Directory reports MIT; preserve upstream attribution/license when installing. Verify license at the pinned upstream revision, especially for the separate pbakaus skill, whose license was not established here.
